Por qué usar macros en WoW Forever, cómo: Why use macros in WoW Forever, how to read them (focus, mouseover, Alt) and create them, shared macros for every class, and racials for every race.
Foco, parada manual y objetos reducen ca: Focus, manual stop commands and item macros reduce target swaps and clicks. Each racial belongs to a race; passive perks need no macro. Check the tournament's consumable and item rules before using them.
En PvP cada cambio de objetivo y cada cl: In PvP, every target swap and click takes attention. A macro combines several commands into one key and lets you choose who gets the spell: the enemy under your cursor, your focus or yourself. You react in fewer steps and make fewer mistakes while moving and watching your opponent.
Interrumpe, controla o disipa a tu foco: Interrupt, CC or dispel your focus or the enemy under your cursor without dropping your damage target. Skip the target, cast and retarget routine.
Con el ratón sobre los marcos de grupo c: Hover over a party frame to heal an ally without changing targets; hold Alt to heal yourself.
Las macros de control empiezan cortando: CC macros start by stopping your current cast, so the control goes out when you press the button.
Las de drenajes y canalizaciones no se r: Drain and channel macros won't restart the channel if you accidentally press them again.
No aumentan el daño por sí solas ni deci: They don't increase damage on their own or make decisions for you. They don't bypass the global cooldown, range, mana or talent requirements. Some stop casts or have specific conditions: read each explanation and practice before competing. Their length has been checked (255 characters), but they haven't been tested in the client.
Todas las macros de la guía siguen el mi: Every macro in this guide follows the same pattern, so each one only needs a few short labels:
El enemigo bajo el ratón o, si no hay, t: The enemy under your cursor or, if there isn't one, your target.
Tu foco. Si no hay un foco enemigo vivo,: Your focus. Does nothing without a living enemy focus.
El aliado de ese marco, sin cambiar tu o: The ally in that frame, without changing your damage target.
Para que Shift funcione necesitas un foc: Shift needs a focus: use the shared Set focus / Alt clear macro.
Escribe <code>/macro</code> en el chat (: Type /macro in chat (or Esc → Macros) and click New.
Ponle un nombre y elige el icono <b>?</b: Give it a name and choose the ? icon: #showtooltip will display the spell's icon.
Pega el texto con «Copiar macro» y arrás: Paste the text using “Copy macro” and drag it onto your action bar.
Revisa en Opciones → Atajos que Shift, C: In Options → Keybindings, check that Shift, Ctrl and Alt aren't assigned to another action on those keys.
El cliente está en inglés: no traduzcas: The client is in English: don't translate spell names.
Ratón sobre una unidad o unidad seleccio: Hover over a unit or select one. Alt clears your focus. Keep a focus for Shift macros.
Recupera el último objetivo enemigo. No: Returns to your last enemy target. Doesn't automatically pick the most dangerous one.
Botón de parada manual para dejar de gol: Manual stop button to avoid attacking a CC'd target or to cancel a cast. Doesn't remove damage-over-time effects already applied.
13 and 14 are your two trinket slots. Only activates an item with an available on-use effect; it doesn't decide when to break CC or bypass its requirements.
Necesitas Heavy Silk Bandage aprendida y: You need to know Heavy Silk Bandage and have one in your bags. Alt targets you; normal targets a living mouseover ally, your selected ally or yourself. Damage or actions can interrupt it; respect Recently Bandaged and the rules for your activity.

26 puntos: 21 por nivel y 5 extras de Le: 26 points: 21 from leveling and 5 extra from Legacy. English client, English explanations. Builds to try in duels, BGs and the open world; not a win-rate ranking or every mathematically possible point allocation.
Repartos comprobados contra filas, rango: Allocations checked against tiers, ranks and prerequisites in the beta dataset from Oct 8, 2026. Support and defensive options have specific roles; they aren't equal in duel damage.
Primera comparación de duelos y mundo ab: First option to compare in duels and the open world: mobility, shapeshifting and physical pressure.
<strong>Feral Combat:</strong> Ferocity: Feral Combat: Ferocity 5/5; Heart of the Wild 3/5; Feral Swiftness 2/2; Brutal Impact 2/2; Thick Hide 3/3; Sharpened Claws 2/2; Savage Fury 2/2; Feral Charge 1/1; Leader of the Pack 1/1.
Sin Shifting Power ni Primal Bite en est: No Shifting Power or Primal Bite in this build; don't copy their macros as if they were baseline abilities.
Comparación caster en duelos y BG: daño: Caster option to compare in duels and BGs: DoTs, roots and casting windows.
<strong>Balance:</strong> Improved Wrath: Balance: Improved Wrath 5/5; Genesis 3/5; Moonglow 3/3; Improved Moonfire 2/2; Nature's Majesty 2/2; Nature's Reach 2/2; Nature's Splendor 1/1; Improved Entangling Roots 2/3; Insect Swarm 1/1; Vengeance 2/5; Nature's Grace 1/1; Eclipse 2/3.
Sin Moonkin Form de 31 puntos. Sigue nec: No 31-point Moonkin Form. You still need to switch to heals and forms depending on pressure.
Primera comparación de curas y movilidad: First healing and mobility option to compare in BGs; also useful for testing resource-based duels.
<strong>Restoration:</strong> Nature&#x2: Restoration: Nature's Focus 5/5; Naturalist 5/5; Natural Shapeshifter 3/3; Reflection 3/3; Gift of Nature 3/5; Swiftmend 1/1; Nature's Swiftness 1/1.
Sin Wild Growth de 31 puntos. Swiftmend: No 31-point Wild Growth. Swiftmend needs a target with the effects required by its tooltip; pressing the button doesn't bypass them.
Cada macro lleva sus teclas en etiquetas: Each macro labels its keys: Shift = your focus, mouseover = the unit under your cursor, Alt = yourself. The focus macro and other shared macros are in the macro guide, along with instructions for creating them.
Cura periódica para ti o un aliado; gest: A HoT for yourself or an ally; mana management is still your call.
Combina lanzamiento y efecto periódico;: Combines a cast with a HoT; find a window to get it off.
Cura de compromiso de lanzamiento; no es: A heal that commits you to a cast; don't expect the macro to make it instant.
En Forever retira Curse o Bane, no todos: In Forever it removes a Curse or Bane, not every debuff.
Solo venenos; no sangrados ni efectos má: Poisons only; not bleeds or every kind of magical effect.
Objetivo y entorno válidos según el clie: Requires a valid target and environment according to the client. Doesn't decide when the root breaks or bypass immunities.
Solo bestias o dragonkin válidos. No due: Only valid Beasts or Dragonkin. Doesn't put every player or pet to sleep.
Daño periódico que puede romper un contr: A DoT can break CC; don't apply it to a target you want to keep asleep.
Ventana de lanzamiento y daño. No lo une: Casting window and damage. Doesn't combine it with a heal or decide which school is best.
Solo con talento Balance. No es una habi: Requires the Balance talent. Not available in every Druid build.
Cambio manual; usa la forma defensiva se: Manual shapeshift; choose your defensive form based on pressure. !Bear Form prevents repeated presses from toggling it off.
Cambio manual. Comprueba en beta la sint: Manual shapeshift. Check ! syntax in the beta; don't add cancelform automatically if you only want to stay in form.
Movilidad cuando el entorno y el cliente: Mobility when the environment and client allow it; doesn't make the form usable everywhere.
Cancels your form and attempts a self-heal. Shapeshifting may need another press; it costs resources and exposes your humanoid form.
Requiere Bear Form y objetivo válido. Pr: Requires Bear Form and a valid target. Shift first if needed; the macro doesn't do it for you.
Solo con talento Feral y forma válida; n: Requires the Feral talent and a valid form; not available in the proposed Balance or Restoration builds.
Requires the right form and stealth conditions. Doesn't automatically combine it with an attack.
Necesita la forma válida y su disponibil: Requires the right form and availability. Not permanent mobility.
Solo con talento Restauración y efecto p: Requires the Restoration talent and a valid HoT on the target, as specified by its tooltip.
Solo Restauración con talento. Elige des: Only available with the Restoration talent. Then choose the heal or Nature spell you want to use with it.
Primera build de ensayo por enfrentamien: First build to test in each matchup. Identify your opponent's spec, race and gear: class alone isn't enough. Practice several rounds before changing points; the suggestions below are tactical proposals, not measured results.
Su amenaza es mantenerte a melee. Observ: Their threat is keeping you in melee. Watch Charge/Intercept, Hamstring and shield swaps; an available Berserker Rage can shut down a fear. A brief gap doesn't mean a safe reset.
Feral compara movilidad y presión física: Feral lets you compare mobility and physical pressure. Shapeshift with a purpose and find room to heal; don't drain your mana with pointless shifts.
Separa sus ventanas de inmunidad, contro: Separate their immunity, CC and healing windows. Save an answer for the next heal after they've spent a defensive; don't pour all your offensive resources into an active immunity.
Administra recursos alrededor de sus def: Manage resources around their defensives. Feral can maintain pressure; Balance lets you compare ranged play. Don't add damage to CC you want to preserve.
Range and pet are two separate threats. Watch slows and traps; CC'ing the pet doesn't remove the Hunter's damage. Avoid chasing in a straight line through prepared ground.
Aprovecha una entrada cuando tenga menos: Close in when they have fewer escape tools; Feral is the first test. Create a healing window without both Hunter and pet hitting you.
La apertura puede encadenar controles; a: The opener can chain CC; manage your CC break and defensives to survive the dangerous stretch. DoTs make resets harder, but can also break your own CC if applied carelessly.
Feral compara defensa física y recuperac: Feral lets you compare physical defense and recovery after the opener. Don't stay in caster form without space; set up CC to heal.
Puede disipar y recuperar vida mientras: They can dispel and recover health while draining your mana. Choose which heal to interrupt instead of answering every cast; pressure without resources can play into their attrition plan.
Feral presiona su ventana de cura; evita: Feral pressures their healing window; avoid an attrition fight that favors better mana management. Don't assume a dispellable HoT will stay up.

First and last names unique across your region, up to three characters per account. Who can reserve and how to do it.

Del 27 de octubre al 3 de noviembre pued: From October 27 to November 3 you can reserve the first and last names of up to three WoW Forever characters. Who can, how to do it and which names aren't allowed.
Reserva tu nombre en WoW Forever: del 27: Reserve your name in WoW Forever: October 27 to November 3
Una semana antes del lanzamiento podrás: A week before launch you'll be able to create your characters and lock in their names. In Forever every character has a first and last name, and the combination must be unique across your whole region. Here's how it works, who can reserve and how to do it.
Como en Forever no hay reinos, los nombr: Since Forever has no realms, names are no longer handed out per realm but per region, and to make room for everyone each character has two names: a first name and a last name. What has to be unique is the combination: if someone is already “Kaelith Hammer”, you can be “Kaelith Wavebreaker”.
El apellido da mucho juego: puedes poner: Last names open up lots of options: give all your characters the same one, like a family (Blizzard's example is Asha, Thalen and Mira Brightvale), or share one with your guild. And if you don't like seeing it above your head, you can hide it: Esc → Options → Nameplates → “My secondary name”. It still shows in chat.
Cómo reservar, paso a paso: How to reserve, step by step
<strong>Hazte con una edición que la inc: Get an edition that includes itReservations come with the Heroic Pack, the Epic Pack or the Warcraft Forever Collection, in the Battle.net shop. A subscription alone doesn't let you reserve: you create your character on launch day.
<strong>Piensa varias combinaciones</str: Think of several combinationsFirst and last name. If the one you want is already taken, having a plan B (and a plan C) saves you from drawing a blank on the spot.
<strong>El 27 de octubre, entra en Battl: On October 27, open Battle.netWorld of Warcraft → WoW: Forever version → Play. Blizzard hasn't said what time it opens: keep an eye on the app and their website that day.
<strong>Elige bien las reglas</strong><s: Choose your ruleset carefullyNormal, PvP or RP. Changing it later costs a paid transfer, and on PvP you can only have one faction per account.
<strong>Crea y personaliza tu personaje<: Create and customize your characterRace, class, appearance, first and last name. You can set up to three characters. Names are reserved first come, first served.
<strong>El 5 de noviembre, a jugar</stro: November 4: play!At 3:00 PM US Pacific Time (midnight on November 5 in Spain) your character will be waiting for you with its name.
Lo que no te van a dejar poner: What you won't be allowed to use
Tienen que cumplir el código de conducta: They must follow the game's naming code of conduct.
Nada que suplante a Blizzard o al equipo: Nothing impersonating Blizzard or the World of Warcraft team, and no confusing names.
El sistema mira <strong>el nombre comple: The system checks the full name: splitting a banned word between first and last name won't fly.
En la beta Blizzard ya ha echado a jugad: In the beta, Blizzard has already removed players over inappropriate names. Don't risk the one you want to keep forever.
Si tu nombre ya está en uso: If your name is already taken
Prueba otro apellido: el nombre puede re: Try another last name: first names can repeat as long as the combination is different.
Usa el generador de nombres aleatorios d: Use the in-game random name generator for inspiration.
Nadie garantiza un nombre: se reservan p: No name is guaranteed: they're reserved first come, first served, so the sooner the better.
Si no tienes la edición, entra el primer: If you don't have an edition, log in on day one: the most wanted names will be gone that very night.

Nota de los desarrolladores: hasta ahora: Developers’ notes: So far in WoW: Forever, experience for killing lower-level enemies while in a party was penalized based on the highest-level member of the party. In Classic Era, that adjustment was made individually for each party member without regard for the highest-level party member. We’ve reverted the calculation to the Classic Era behavior, where only the individual's level matters. We believe the combination of these two changes will dramatically increase experience earned in dungeons for most players.
Nota de los desarrolladores: como antes,: Developers’ notes: As before, if a member of the party is at a vastly higher level than the enemy being killed, then no player in the party will receive XP, as intended.

Nota de los desarrolladores: Los aumento: Developers’ notes: Critical Strike damage increases early on in trees are exciting for other specializations, but its not as exciting for the core specialization while leveling, since they don't have enough critical strike chance to really appreciate it. Today the mad Arugal reigns among wolves, ghosts of the guard and the specter of the baron himself. Small rooms, twisting corridors and dark courtyards make every pull a risk, and the last boss plays with line of sight and teleports.

The group goes in through the sewers and comes out into the city streets, all the way to the Violet Hold and the room where the shade of an archmage awaits. It's large, with eight bosses (one secret) and almost everything is immune to arcane damage.

Horde: special tunnel next to the Image of Archmage Modera; at least one group member needs the Dalaran Sewer Key (chain from Tarren Mill with Magus Wordeen Voidglare: "Prison Break In", "Key to the City", "Dalaran Patrols", "Blood in the Streets" and "Heart of Disruption"). Shortcut: swim from Silverpine Forest (The Sepulcher).

Frente a la costa de Tuercespina ha vuel: Off the coast of Stranglethorn, I'lalai has risen from the sea again: an ancient troll city that sank centuries ago, perhaps raised by dark magic. It's now occupied by undead trolls, naga and makrura, as well as pirates who got trapped there. According to the demo, it starts as a linear path and opens up into large spaces, with lower districts, corridors and a water area where something huge lurks; enemy packs are tightly packed.

En lo alto de la Montaña Roca Negra se a: Atop Blackrock Mountain rises the fortress that the black dragon Nefarian seized from the Dark Iron dwarves. The lower part has been taken by the orc Rend Blackhand's Dark Horde: Spirestone ogres, Smolderthorn trolls, spiders and worgs that serve as the antechamber to the Black Dragonflight's domain. It's long, with many paths and bosses, and it's where you get the seal that opens Upper Spire.
Dentro de la Montaña Roca Negra, entre l: Inside Blackrock Mountain, between the Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes. Inside, climb the chains from the central platform to the second-floor ledge and follow the wall to the only balcony: the Blackrock Spire portal is there. Lower Spire doesn't need a key. Upper Blackrock Spire (UBS) requires the Seal of Ascension, obtained through the quest of the same name: it starts inside Lower Spire (Scarshield Infiltrator) by collecting the gems dropped by LBRS bosses.
Rangos Forever: Icy Veins (beta) 55-60;: Forever level ranges: Icy Veins (beta) 55-60; Warcraft Tavern 57-60. Upper Blackrock Spire (UBS) appears in Forever guides as a separate level 60 dungeon (Icy Veins 59-60, Warcraft Tavern 60), and the two count separately for the Legacy challenge "Master Spelunker" (Icy Veins). Dungeon sets (Tier 0 / Dungeon Set 1): the pieces that drop here in Classic (Wildheart, Beaststalker, Shadowcraft, Boots of Elements) exist in the Forever data with retuned stats and set bonuses reworked into 2/3/4/5/6 pieces (e.g. Beaststalker: 2 = +8 to all resistances, 3 = +30 attack power…), according to Wowhead's Forever tooltips; Icy Veins says the vanilla versions of T0 are visible and that Blizzard might end up using other variants, so it's not confirmed they'll keep dropping. Some boss items already have Forever data (Blackcrow goes to +0.9% hit). According to Icy Veins, Blackrock Spire has 249 hidden items and 32 revealed: the Classic loot may change. In addition, loot unlocks appearances for everyone and dungeon experience shifts mostly to quests. The beta only goes up to level 30: it hasn't been possible to test it.

La antigua capital de los gnomos, una ci: The old gnome capital, an underground city full of machinery that its people had to abandon when the troggs rose up from the depths. To drive them out, Mekgineer Thermaplugg proposed flooding it with radiation, and the cure was worse than the disease: many gnomes were trapped and turned into lepers, while the troggs were mutated but still alive. Thermaplugg, the traitor, stayed inside as lord of the ruins, surrounded by robots and walking bombs.

There is a back door to the north of the outer area that opens with the Workshop Key, dropped by Electrocutioner 6000 inside.

Eldre&#x27;Thalas fue una ciudad de los: Eldre'Thalas was a city of the Highborne high elves that was left in ruins after the War of the Ancients. Today the Gordok ogres have taken over the north wing and fight over the throne, satyrs and corrupted trees fill the east wing, and in the west wing the last of the Shen'dralar keep a demon imprisoned to keep feeding their magic. It's a big, maze-like dungeon, famous for its libraries and for the «tribute run».
Centro de Feralas, entre Feathermoon Str: Central Feralas, between Feathermoon Stronghold and Camp Mojache: you enter the Dire Maul compound from the south (~59,45) and reach the three wings from there. East: no key. West and North: need the Crescent Key (item 18249), which you get from Pusillin in the East wing (a Rogue can pick the doors; in the North, the Gordok Courtyard Key from the courtyard opens the inner passage). Tribute (North wing): reach King Gordok without killing the guards or Captain Kromcrush (Frost Oil to freeze Guard Slip'kik and the Gordok Ogre Suit so Kromcrush lets you through); when the king dies an extra chest appears and the ogres give 2-hour buffs.
Sigue en el juego con sus tres alas como: It stays in the game with its three wings as separate dungeons in the Dungeon Finder. Forever level ranges: Icy Veins (beta): East 54-60, North 56-60, West 56-60; Warcraft Tavern: East 58-60, West 60, North 60. Icy Veins includes it in the «Master Spelunker» Legacy challenge (East, West and North separately). Loot: Blizzard has revamped the loot of the classic dungeons (hundreds of new items, according to Warcraft Tavern quoting the developers) and every item that drops unlocks its appearance for everyone who could loot it; according to Icy Veins, Dire Maul's 196 items are still hidden in the Forever data (0 revealed), so the loot below is the Classic loot and may change. Dungeon experience shifts mostly to quests (repeat runs give much less). The beta only goes up to level 30, so this dungeon hasn't been testable.

Bajo los canales de Ventormenta está la: Beneath the canals of Stormwind lies the kingdom's high-security prison, where thieves, Defias rebels, murderers and the odd Blackrock orc are locked up. The prisoners have rioted and taken over the cells, and the guards are asking for help to put down the revolt. It's a short, T-shaped dungeon of corridors and cells, with bosses that usually wait with company.

Cuevas sagradas de los centauros bajo el: Sacred centaur caves beneath the Valley of Spears, where Zaetar, son of Cenarius, lies at rest after being murdered by his own centaur children. His lover, the earth elemental princess Theradras, guards the place, and her corruption has turned the grottos into a maze of crystals, poisonous waterfalls and monstrous plants. It is long and freely explorable: two wings (purple and orange) and an inner section with waterfalls where the princess awaits.
Valle de las Lanzas, Desolace (Icy Veins: Valley of Spears, Desolace (Icy Veins Classic: 30, 62; Warcraft Tavern Classic places the Stone Door on the west side of the valley around 38, 58). You cross some outer caves to a junction with three portals: purple wing (left), orange wing (right) and the central portal to the inner section. In Classic the central portal requires the Scepter of Celebras (quest Legends of Maraudon + The Scepter of Celebras); without it you reach the inner section by going through one of the wings.
Warcraft Tavern (guía de mazmorras de Fo: Warcraft Tavern (Forever dungeon guide) gives it the 45-51 range. There is no dedicated Forever guide or published Forever loot table. In Wowhead's Forever database the classic loot appears tweaked with archetype itemization: Fist of Stone gains armor and returns triple mana against earth elementals, golems and titan-forged; Charstone Dirk becomes a healing weapon (+116 healing); Eye of Theradras swaps stats for crit; Claw of Celebras and Princess Theradras' Scepter get stronger effects. Blade of Eternal Darkness, Gemshard Heart, Helm of the Mountain, Satyr's Lash, Gizlock's Hypertech Buckler, Noxxion's Shackles and Rockgrip Gauntlets don't appear in the Forever database. The Scepter of Celebras still exists unchanged. Forever in general: dungeon experience is concentrated in its quests (in the beta, 50% less bonus XP from dungeon quests) and everything that drops unlocks its appearance. In Desolace the beta adds new Gelkis and Magram quests (from level 35), which are not part of the dungeon.

Las antiguas minas de oro de Ventormenta: Stormwind's old gold mines, abandoned during the First War, are now the lair of the Defias Brotherhood: the stonemasons the kingdom never paid for rebuilding the capital, who turned to banditry under Edwin VanCleef. Past tunnels full of miners, goblins and engineers lies a huge cave with a half-built pirate ship. It is the most famous dungeon in the game and, for many Alliance players, their first.
Páramos de Poniente, en el pueblo de Moo: Westfall, in the village of Moonbrook, in the south of the zone; you enter through the Defias Hideout (building in the southwest of the village, 42.4, 72.6 according to warcraft.wiki.gg) and go down through the mines to the portal. No key. It's a long way for the Horde (boat or zeppelin and a trip along the coast).

La Cruzada Escarlata, una orden de fanát: The Scarlet Crusade, an order of zealots born to fight the undead Scourge that ended up seeing enemies everywhere, made this monastery its great stronghold in Tirisfal Glades. Behind its walls lie torture chambers, a graveyard that no longer rests, a library of forbidden lore, an armory full of soldiers and a cathedral ruled by Commander Mograine and Inquisitor Whitemane. It is one of the most farmed dungeons for leveling, because each wing is quick to clear.
Claros de Tirisfal, en el extremo norest: Tirisfal Glades, in the far northeast. Inside the main building there is one portal per wing: Graveyard (the leftmost open one) and Library (the rightmost open one) with no requirement; Armory (locked door on the right) and Cathedral (locked door on the left) need The Scarlet Key, which is in a chest behind Arcanist Doan in the Library (or have a rogue pick the lock). The Horde gets there easily from Undercity; the Alliance comes through Silverpine Forest from Hillsbrad Foothills or the Alterac Mountains.
Cuatro alas con portal propio. Rangos de: Four wings, each with its own portal. Warcraft Tavern ranges (Forever guides): Graveyard 30-38, Library 33-41, Armory 36-44, Cathedral 38-46. It was already available in the beta before the level 30 cap increase (notes from 1-10). Whitemane's Chapeau (Cathedral) doesn't appear in Wowhead's Forever database, a sign that that wing's loot has changed. General beta changes: dungeon quests give 50% less bonus experience; several dungeon quest rewards drop from blue to green (notes from 8-10); dungeon enemies give 20% more experience.

La famosa prisión de la isla de Alcaz, f: The famous prison on Alcaz Island, off the northeast coast of Dustwallow Marsh, finally opens its doors. It is the place of the rumors about King Varian Wrynn's captivity at the hands of the Defias, and now Defias inmates and naga fight over it. Warcraft Tavern compares it to a high-level Stormwind Stockade.
Isla de Alcaz, frente a la costa noreste: Alcaz Island, off the northeast coast of Dustwallow Marsh (near Theramore). How to cross to the island, entrance coordinates and requirements: not published.
Mazmorra nueva de Forever. En Classic la: New Forever dungeon. In Classic you could visit Alcaz Island (Doctor Weavil, Strashaz naga), but the prison had no playable interior. Blizzard calls it «Alcaz Prison» in its official table; Icy Veins and Warcraft Tavern also use «Alcaz Island Prison».
Lucharás contra Defias y nagas a la vez:: You'll fight Defias and naga at the same time: bring interrupts for the naga casters and crowd control for the humanoids.
Theramore (Alianza) y Brackenwall (Horda: Theramore (Alliance) and Brackenwall (Horde) are the closest bases: set your hearthstone there before you go.
Prepara cómo llegar a la isla antes de q: Work out how to reach the island before meeting up with the group, because it's separated from the mainland.

Bajo la Montaña Roca Negra se extiende l: Beneath Blackrock Mountain lies the capital of the Dark Iron dwarves, Shadowforge City, built by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan in the service of the Firelord Ragnaros. It is the largest five-player dungeon in the game: a prison, a gladiator arena, forges, a tavern with its own brew and a palace where Princess Moira Bronzebeard, abducted from Ironforge, has married the emperor. A full run can take hours, so it is usually done in sections.
Montaña Roca Negra, entre la Garganta de: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes. Inside the mountain, cross the chain to the central island, go down to a ledge above the lava and go through the Grinding Quarry to the portal. Shadowforge Key: reward from Dark Iron Legacy (Franclorn Forgewright, a ghost above his tomb in the middle of the mountain, only visible while dead): you recover the hammer Ironfel from Fineous Darkvire and place it in the Shrine of Thaurissan; it opens the Shadowforge Gates and the East Garrison door (a shortcut that skips the Ring of Law). Prison Cell Key: dropped by High Interrogator Gerstahn, it opens the cells of Kharan Mighthammer, Marshal Windsor and Commander Gor'shak. Rogues can pick these locks.
Warcraft Tavern (guía de mazmorras de Fo: Warcraft Tavern (Forever dungeon guide) keeps the 52-60 range. There is no dedicated Forever guide or published Forever loot table. In Wowhead's Forever database some of the classic loot appears tweaked: the Ring of Law's Savage Gladiator set becomes 6 pieces (adding Savage Gladiator Shoulders) with new bonuses (reduced chance to be feared, attack power, attack speed when no allies are nearby) and the chest gets higher stats; Lord General's Sword gives +84 attack power for 10 sec (previously +50 for 30 sec); Golem Skull Helm goes up to +8 defense. Famous items that don't appear in the Forever database: Ironfoe, Hand of Justice, Robes of the Royal Crown, Naglering, Lavastone Hammer, Guiding Stave of Wisdom, Flame Wrath, Dreadforge Retaliator, Force of Will, Second Wind and Ebonsteel Spaulders. Shadowforge Key and Prison Cell Key still exist. Forever in general: dungeon experience is concentrated in its quests (in the beta, 50% less bonus XP from dungeon quests) and everything that drops unlocks its appearance.

Sobre Entrañas, la vieja capital de Lord: Above Undercity, the old capital of Lordaeron is still full of the Scourge: spiders, abominations, skeletons and necromancers that the Forsaken want to drive out to reclaim their city. It is a dark, convoluted dungeon, with many rooms and optional bosses.

Stratholme fue la gran ciudad del norte: Stratholme was the great city of northern Lordaeron until the plagued grain reached its streets and Prince Arthas ordered it purged. Today its ruins are still burning: Baron Rivendare’s Scourge holds the ziggurats on the east side, while in the west the zealots of the Scarlet Crusade, led by a dreadlord in disguise, dig in at their bastion. It is the most iconic dungeon of late Classic, with two very different wings.
Norte de las Tierras de la Peste del Est: Northern Eastern Plaguelands (main entrance around 27,12). Main Gate: leads to the “live” (Scarlet) side, no key needed; the Scarlet Bastion opens with The Scarlet Key. Service Gate: southeast of the main one, leads straight to Baron Rivendare’s undead side and opens with the Key to the City (item 12382), dropped by Magistrate Barthilas; without it you can get there by crossing over from the live side, but it takes much longer.
En Forever figura como dos mazmorras: Ic: In Forever it is listed as two dungeons: Icy Veins (beta) “Stratholme (Main Gate)” and “Stratholme (Service Gate)”, 58-60; Warcraft Tavern “Stratholme – Living” and “Stratholme – Undead”, 58-60. The two wings count separately for the “Master Spelunker” Legacy challenge (Icy Veins). Baron Rivendare's mount (Deathcharger's Reins) exists in the Forever data as an account-wide mount that requires Journeyman Riding (Wowhead Forever tooltip). Dungeon sets (Tier 0): the pieces that drop here in Classic exist in Forever with reworked stats and 2/3/4/5/6-piece bonuses (2 = +8 to all resistances; Valor 3 = +15 Strength…), according to Wowhead's Forever tooltips; Icy Veins warns it could use other variants, so it is not confirmed they drop the same way. Some boss items already have Forever data with changes (Mask of the Unforgiven gains +6 Defense; Shroud of the Nathrezim switches to general crit and spell power). Una cámara de los titanes enterrada bajo: A titan vault buried beneath the Badlands, which the dwarves of Ironforge began excavating in search of their origins. Now it is overrun by troggs and Dark Iron dwarves, and the stone guardians left behind by the titans still stand watch. At the far end, in Khaz'mul's chamber, the giant Archaedas awakens to defend the Discs of Norgannon, which hold the true history of the dwarves.
Tierras Inhóspitas, al norte, junto al p: Northern Badlands, next to the pass to Loch Modan, around 44, 12: you have to cross the excavation tunnels, full of elites. Back door in Dustwind Gulch, around 66, 43, in another cave with elite troggs. No key to get in (minimum level 30 in the beta). Inside: Ironaya's door opens with the Staff of Prehistoria (Gni'kiv Medallion from the Lost Dwarves' chest + The Shaft of Tsol from Revelosh) placed on the keystone; Archaedas is awakened by using the altar in front of him; the Discs of Norgannon (quest “The Platinum Discs”) are in his room.
Se abrió en la beta con la subida a nive: It opened in the beta with the level cap raise to 30 (Oct 1 notes: “Uldaman (30+)”). Warcraft Tavern (Forever guide) lists it as 36-45, well below Classic. According to that guide, the Lost Dwarves (Baelog, Eric and Olaf) are only hostile to the Horde. New quest rewards confirmed in the Forever database: Doomcaller's Pants and Fists of Impending Doom (“Solution to Doom”). Loot that goes up in quality in Forever: Baelog's Shortbow and Battered Viking Shield (white to blue) and Galgann's Firehammer (green to blue). Stoneslayer and The Rockpounder (Archaedas) and Expert Goldminer's Helmet (Digmaster Shovelphlange) don't appear in Wowhead's Forever database. General beta changes: dungeon quests give 50% less bonus experience and dungeon enemies give 20% more.

La otra gran madriguera de los jabaespin: The other great warren of the quilboar, beneath the brambles of the southern Barrens, where the tribe has joined the Scourge. Amnennar the Coldbringer, a servant of the Lich King, has taken over the place and the quilboar worship him while his cultists raise the dead. Bones, cobwebs and necromancy everywhere: a warning of what awaits in the Plaguelands.
Los Baldíos, en el extremo sureste, haci: The Barrens, in the far southeast, around 43, 95 according to Warcraft Tavern, next to the Great Lift to Thousand Needles. Before the portal there is a maze of brambles full of elite quilboar. No key; minimum level 25 in the beta.
Se abrió en la beta con la subida a nive: It opened in the beta with the level cap raise to 30 (Oct 1 notes: “Razorfen Downs (25+)”). Warcraft Tavern (Forever guide) lists it as 37-46. Antigua joya troll de Tanaris, hoy una c: Once a jewel of the trolls in Tanaris, today an adobe city half-buried in the sand where the Sandfury breed an army of the undead. It is a dungeon almost entirely in the open air (you can ride your mount), famous for the pyramid battle, in which waves of trolls charge down the stairs at the group, and for the hydra demigod Gahz'rilla, asleep in the sacred pool. Inside you will also find the two halves of the sword Sul'thraze.
Noroeste de Tanaris, al oeste de Gadgetz: Northwestern Tanaris, west of Gadgetzan (Icy Veins Classic: 39, 18). No key. To summon Gahz'rilla in Classic you need the Mallet of Zul'Farrak (consecrated at the Altar of Zul, The Hinterlands); the gong that replaces it arrived in patch 3.0.8.
Warcraft Tavern (guía de mazmorras de Fo: Warcraft Tavern (Forever dungeon guide) gives it a 40-47 range. There is no dedicated Forever guide for Zul'Farrak or published Forever loot table. What you can see in Wowhead's Forever database is that the classic loot has been reworked with the new archetype-based itemization: Sul'thraze the Lasher reduces attack power and its extra Shadow damage deals double against trolls; Gahz'rilla Fang builds up Static Electricity as you move and deals double against water-based enemies; Zum'rah's Vexing Cane can summon a zombie troll when casting spells; Big Bad Pauldrons swaps Spirit for health regeneration; Sang'thraze and Jang'thraze go up in item level. Ripsaw doesn't appear in the Forever database. Forever-wide changes: dungeon experience is concentrated in its quests (in the beta, 50% less bonus XP from dungeon quests) and everything that drops unlocks its appearance for anyone who can use it.

El diseñador de encuentros adelantó que: The encounter designer revealed that there are mansions and instance portals hidden around the world that people have already found, and that they will be content «in the future». He didn't say when or what.
En la beta hay un aprendiz de joyero en: In the beta there is a jewelcrafting apprentice in Dalaran and a scribe in Durotar who tell you to come back later, and the Inscription skill already shows up on the character sheet. Blizzard has not announced it.
Blizzard ha dicho que llegarán, pero más: Blizzard has said they will come, but later and with no date. At launch there will be Normal, PvP, Roleplay and Roleplay-PvP.
En la beta la gente usaba las hogueras p: In the beta people were using campfires to kill other players. They say they will review it without removing all the damage. They haven't said how it will end up.
Botín de misiones para todo el grupo: Quest loot for the whole group
Se lo pidieron en el pódcast: que los ob: It was asked on the podcast: that quest items show up for the whole group. Answer: «never say never». They have already improved it somewhat and don't rule out tuning it further.
Jugar con gente de América: Playing with people from the Americas
No al lanzamiento: Europa y América van: Not at launch: Europe and the Americas are separate. They don't rule it out for later, but it has technical complications. Within Europe you can choose your preferred language in the options.
Algo parecido a una sintonización en las: Something like an attunement in the new raids
Onyxia sigue con su cadena de siempre, p: Onyxia's Lair keeps its usual chain, per character. Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit won't have an attunement that stops you from entering, but they will have «something similar» that you'll have to discover by investigating to get the full experience. And for later: «there is no world in which we don't do attunements», each raid in its own way.
En Season of Discovery los metieron en i: In Season of Discovery they put them in instances. For Forever they haven't decided: they want to bring back the fight over a scarce resource, without promising anything.
Les gustaría traer eventos de Season of: They would like to bring Season of Discovery events like the Battle for Ashenvale or the Stranglethorn Blood Moon. The Eastern Plaguelands towers and the war in Silithus will not be there at launch; they would want to redo them later.
Ya existe una arena de duelos en un crát: A duel arena already exists in a crater on Mount Hyjal (it was used in the tournament), with vendors and maybe an NPC that resets cooldowns, but «it's not ready». It could open in a future patch or seasonally, like the Darkmoon Faire. Group-versus-group challenges in battlegrounds (no honor) would come «soon after» launch.
Muy reacios: no quieren arenas como en B: Very reluctant: they don't want arenas like in Burning Crusade or PvP-only stats. They prefer 10-vs-10 and 15-vs-15 fights. They don't completely rule it out.
Quieren ir a <strong>Gilneas, Uldum y Qu: They want to go to Gilneas, Uldum and Quel'Thalas (shown at BlizzCon), with no date. They also talk about zones like Stromgarde, turned into high-level open zones, and dungeon entrances in high-level zones: «there may already be one and nobody has found it».
Los objetos no aparecen en los archivos: Items don't appear in the files until someone gets them: nobody knows yet what each boss drops. And there will be rare undiscovered recipes, for example Engineering bombs, that will only drop by farming.
Tras las críticas a sus modelos, llegará: After the criticism of their models, new ones will arrive in the first big update, in early 2027. There will be a blog post.
Ahora se activa a nivel 40. Están hablan: It now activates at level 40. They are discussing whether to change that level.
Los cielonatos de la Horda no pueden ser: Horde Skyborne can't be priests. Players ask for it a lot and the answer was «never say never».
Y esto ya es seguro: lo dijeron en el pó: And this is already certain: they said it on the podcast
<strong>Mazmorras sin mapa ni diario</st: Dungeons without a map or journal, and without meeting stones that summon: the journey is part of the dungeon.
<strong>Las mazmorras dan un 20 % más de: Dungeons give 20% more experience per enemy, but running them on repeat won't be the fastest way: they want you to go out into the world.
<strong>Más de mil misiones nuevas</stro: More than a thousand new quests, mostly from Riverglades (level 40) onward.
<strong>Vuelve el rango 14</strong> con: Rank 14 returns with its armor. Alterac Valley will give less honor and the other battlegrounds quite a bit more, so that rotating them pays off.
<strong>Los grupos hechos se enfrentan a: Premade groups face premade groups: if you go solo or with a few friends you shouldn't land against one.
<strong>En los reinos JcJ no protegerán: On PvP realms they won't protect low-level players from level 60s: they only step in if there is cheating.
<strong>Sin buffs de mundo dentro de las: No world buffs inside the raids. All the classic consumables remain, and resistances count.
<strong>Mano dura con el oro comprado</s: Tough on bought gold: in the beta they closed more than 2,100 buyer accounts and about 1,600 seller and bot accounts.

NO OFFICIAL NOTE · 28 OCTOBER

Unannounced changes: Ice Lance with an 8 s cooldown and hunters with less attack power

They appeared in the game without Blizzard notes: mages, hunters and some items. They are in «Half-confirmed» until Blizzard confirms them.
Libros del mundo y la Investigación del: World books and the mage's Research
Los libros que encuentras por el mundo s: Books you find around the world are handed in to a librarian (in the Stormwind Mage Tower for the Alliance and in the Undercity for the Horde) and give experience. At book milestones you choose rewards: first a necklace (stamina and spirit, or agility and stamina), then a ring, and around level 40 a bow, a healer shield or a fire off-hand. It is not clear how many books each milestone needs. Mages also learn to research once a day with a light feather and get scrolls; levelling it up unlocks rewards, including a weapon for melee mages.
Blizzard estudia un banco compartido ent: Blizzard is looking into a bank shared between your characters, like Retail's Warband bank, to move items without the mail. They see it as possible «in the relatively near future», without promising it.
El equipo dice que también lo quiere y q: The team says they want it too and talk about it often, but there is no date or design.
Monturas en los datos que no son de Fore: Mounts in the data that are not for Forever
En la beta aparecieron en los archivos u: In the beta, the files contained a pack of spectral wolves, a green sea turtle, a crimson rooster, pets and transmog sets. Blizzard has clarified that they are not for Forever. The shop appears disabled in character creation.
En los datos del mapa el Cráter de Azsha: In the map data, Azshara Crater appears rebuilt and nearly finished: most likely it is Blackwing Bastion, although it could be a battleground. There is also new terrain south of Uldum and a complete Gilneas.
Tras las batallas enormes de la beta (Or: After the huge battles in the beta (Orgrimmar, Ashenvale), Blizzard is looking into linking several groups into an «army» of 80 to 120 people for guild, RP or PvP events. Also into servers detecting large world PvP fights and giving them more capacity. Nothing announced: the maximum is still a 40-player raid.
Ideas que barajan: más eventos de JcJ gr: Ideas they are considering: more large PvP events, fishing contests, something like the Blood Moon, the Mak'gora arena and seasonal fairs like the Darkmoon Faire. World bosses and community events could be adapted to the new phasing system. No dates.

The roots from Counterattack, Entrapment and Improved Wing Clip now share diminishing returns with Improved Hamstring (warrior) and Frostbite (mage): the more in a row, the shorter they last.
Pódcast 6 (29 de octubre): cómo funciona: Podcast 6 (29 October): how the servers work
<strong>Sin reinos de los de antes:</str: No old-style realms: you choose a ruleset (Normal, PvP, RP or RP-PvP) and play. You can play with friends from all over Europe; America stays separate.
<strong>Menos saltos de fase al cruzar d: Fewer phase jumps when crossing zones: in the beta people vanished when moving from one zone to another. It improved a lot at the end of the beta and there will be more fixes for launch, although they warn that some «world» changes will still happen.
<strong>Unirte a un grupo ya no te cambi: Joining a group no longer moves you to another world instantly: you get a prompt and choose when to move.
<strong>Te ponen con gente conocida:</st: You are placed with people you know: the game tries to put you in the same phase as your guild, your friends and people you have played with, to build community. Your client language also counts.
<strong>Zonas con gente, pero sin agobio: Busy zones, but not crowded: in the beta Westfall and the Barrens got too full and they lowered the cap. On day one there will be more new players in Durotar than in Orgrimmar.
<strong>Equilibrio de facciones:</strong: Faction balance: they aim for about 50% in each ruleset. If a faction goes over the limit, they can block character creation for that faction.
<strong>JcJ y JcE siguen separados</stro: PvP and PvE stay separate, each with its own economy.
<strong>Ignorar a alguien no lo saca de: Ignoring someone does not remove them from your world: you just stop seeing their messages.
<strong>El lanzamiento no trae eventos g: Launch does not bring big new events: first everything has to work, and content will arrive gradually. They rebuilt the event system after the problems with the Battle for Ashenvale.
<strong>El pódcast descansa la semana de: The podcast takes launch week off and returns two weeks later with a lore episode.
Things spotted while playing the beta. They may change at launch and we do not know some of the names in Spanish yet.
<strong>Mascota secreta en Entrañas:</st: Secret pet in the Undercity: with a Horde character, buy slime food in the Apothecarium, find the excitable ooze in the green pool and dance (/dance) at it several times until it becomes friendly. It gives you a quest and you learn the pet, which is account-wide.
<strong>La antorcha del Bosque del Ocaso: The Duskwood torch: next to the dead Night Watch members around the zone, a quest starts that gives you the torch.
<strong>Ranas cantoras en la Isla de Zep: Singing frogs on Zephras Isle (the Skyborne starting zone): target one of the five frogs, type /sing and in the end one appears that gives you a pet. A nod to Zelda.
<strong>Atajo al Marjal Revolcafango:</s: Shortcut to Bogpaddle Marsh: in the north of the Shimmering Flats area (Thousand Needles) there is a new subzone, with a burnt tree and planks along the map edge, that leads to the marsh without crossing the Barrens.
<strong>Casa de subastas del mercado neg: Black Market Auction House: like Retail's. In the beta a turtle mount appeared starting at about 3,000 gold, and only one person gets it.
<strong>Cadena del Mártir</strong> (pech: Martyr's Chain (chest piece, dropped by mobs in Blackfathom Deeps): if you die wearing it, it deals holy damage to nearby enemies.
<strong>Pala de saqueatumbas</strong> (l: Grave robber's shovel (dropped by Dextren in the Stockade, 20 uses): to dig graves in Raven Hill and in the Scarlet Monastery graveyard. Mostly gives grave moss.
<strong>Ojo con el mortero goblin:</stro: Careful with the goblin mortar: reloading it with Engineering can go wrong, launch you into the air and kill you.
<strong>Fingir muerte puede matarte:</st: Feign Death can kill you: if you let it run to the end, the hunter really dies.
<strong>Iconos de raza clásicos:</strong: Classic race icons: if you choose the classic models, the race icon is the old one too.
<strong>Tormentas de verdad:</strong> co: Real storms: rain comes with thunder and lightning that lights up the zone.
<strong>La isla de los GM</strong> se ve: The GM island can be seen on the horizon from Teldrassil thanks to the new view distance. You cannot get there.
<strong>Un goblin junto a una arena vací: A goblin next to an empty arena in the Riverglades says it does not work yet. Blizzard still does not want arenas like in The Burning Crusade.

Lo que contó Blizzard el 29 de octubre:: What Blizzard said on 29 October: patches every 4 months, 4-month PvP seasons, where Forever could go and how the servers will work.
Blizzard: un parche grande cada 4 meses,: Blizzard: a major patch every 4 months, and what comes next
A una semana del lanzamiento, Blizzard h: One week before launch, Blizzard explained in an interview and on the official podcast what Forever's pace will be, where it could go and how the servers will work. Here are the key points.
El ritmo: un parche grande cada 4 meses: The pace: a major patch every 4 months
<strong>Unos 4 meses (17 semanas) entre: About 4 months (17 weeks) between major patches, roughly three times a year. In Season of Discovery they went every 8-10 weeks and felt it was too fast.
<strong>Dentro de cada parche se irán ab: Within each patch things will unlock after one, two or three months, so not everything comes out on day one.
Encaja con el calendario que ya conocemo: It fits the calendar we already know: raids on 9 December and the first major update in early 2027. Calendar.
<strong>El camino clásico:</strong> Núcl: The classic path: Molten Core, Blackwing Lair and Ahn'Qiraj will come, but more spread out than in Classic.
<strong>Sitios nuevos que «encajan»</str: New places that «fit», like the Riverglades: future dungeons and raids will go there too.
<strong>Cosas muy distintas</strong>, co: Very different things, like the Skyborne and Zephras Isle.
<strong>El Portal Oscuro, Rasganorte y P: The Dark Portal, Northrend and Pandaria exist, and there could be short trips there (a dungeon or a quest that takes you and brings you back), but not soon. You will always return to the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.
<strong>Dos configuraciones de talentos<: Two talent loadouts are enough for them for now.
<strong>Sin reinos:</strong> eliges regl: No realms: you choose a ruleset and play with people from all over Europe.
<strong>Menos cambios de fase forzados:<: Fewer forced phase changes: joining a group no longer moves you instantly; you get a prompt and some time to choose when.
<strong>Te juntan con tu comunidad:</str: You are grouped with your community: the game tries to place you with your guild, your friends and people you have played with.
<strong>Al cruzar de zona aún puede desa: People may still vanish when crossing zones, although it has improved. On day one there will be many more players in Durotar than in Orgrimmar and they will keep adjusting it.
<strong>Batallas enormes de JcJ:</strong: Huge PvP battles: they are looking into servers detecting them and giving them more capacity. What you saw at the end of the beta is what launch will have.
